inputs.prompt: Does Project Minimi say Cotton takes screenshots? How does it read what is on the Mac screen?

inputs.user_text: Does Project Minimi say Cotton takes screenshots? How does it read what is on the Mac screen?

tool_calls.name: web_search
tool_calls.arguments: {"queries": ["Project Minimi Cotton screenshots Mac screen reading", "Cotton app Mac screen capture accessibility API"], "intent": "answer"}

queries.query: Project Minimi Cotton screenshots Mac screen reading
Cotton app Mac screen capture accessibility API

outputs.content:
**No — per the vendor's own description, Minimi does not take screenshots.** It reads what's on your Mac screen through macOS **Accessibility** APIs instead of capturing images.

**Cotton's role:** Cotton is the memory side of Minimi 2.0 — it accumulates the context of what you read, hear, and do on your Mac into a private, on-device memory layer (Melody, the other character, tracks unfinished commitments) [S5](https://www.nextfor.ai/products/minimi-2-0-2), [S9](https://chatgate.ai/en/post/minimi-2-0#1).

**How it reads the screen:** A review of the product states that the official site says it reads screen content via macOS Accessibility rather than screenshots; microphone and system-audio capture require separate permissions, and the policy notes that recording other people's conversations requires any legally required consent [S8](https://aitrovex.com/zh-hans/tool/minimi). Memories are stored as embeddings in a local vector database on your Mac, and the company says nothing is kept on its servers or used for training [S5](https://www.nextfor.ai/products/minimi-2-0-2), [S2](https://www.projectminimi.com/memory).

Two caveats:
- The Accessibility-vs-screenshot wording comes from a third-party summary of the site, not a direct quote from the vendor page I retrieved; the official memory page I checked only says memory stays on your Mac and that it uses "the same permissions as WisprFlow" [S2](https://www.projectminimi.com/memory).
- The search digest was truncated, so I can't rule out that the site elsewhere mentions optional screenshot-based features.

**Sources**
- [S2](https://www.projectminimi.com/memory) — minimi memory page
- [S5](https://www.nextfor.ai/products/minimi-2-0-2) — minimi 2.0 features overview
- [S8](https://aitrovex.com/zh-hans/tool/minimi) — aitrovex product summary (Accessibility vs. screenshots)
- [S9](https://chatgate.ai/en/post/minimi-2-0#1) — chatgate.ai on minimi 2.0
